protocol: W-BED.md §2.3: author fixtures = wbed dev seeds 373-378 (inputs + referenceSolve outputs, d3 and d4); one validation on dev seeds 301-312 (d3, d4); because judges were stubs ($0), the '< 10/12' revision trigger was met for both rungs and each got its one revision; frozen whatever the score. bedFinding.claimStatus: no longer blocks: wbed-r3 1.0.0 results (and wbed-r4/r5 1.0.0 tasks with an R3 pack) stay invalid for totals
bedFinding.finding: The R3 oracle's by_reason usd_cents and totals are not reproducible from the task: on all 12 author fixtures the labelled values differ from the spec's rule ('add each supplier's amounts per reason, convert that sum once at the quote below, half away from zero') by +1 to +50 cents per reason; no reading of the printed quotes (per supplier, per discrepancy, per currency, rounding once) reproduces them, consistent with truth computed at rates more precise than the 4-decimal quotes the spec prints. With the correct reason on every discrepancy, the reference's statements equal the bed reference's in 36/36 tasks and its totals in 0/36, so the oracle fails it 36/36; a black-box probe (the reference's answer with the bed reference's totals swapped in) passes on fixtures 373 d3, 373 d4, 374 d3 and 375 d3.
bedFinding.rootCause: beds/wbed/lib/fx.mjs drawQuotes stored USD-per-unit rates at six decimals (mulRate(round(rate*1e6))) while lib/domain.mjs quoteLine prints four (microText truncates at >= 0.05); records quantizes to the printed precision (records/world.mjs quant), R3 did not. 70 of 106 non-USD quotes on dev 301-312 and 373-378 (d3, d4) had hidden digits
bedFinding.resolution: drawQuotes quantizes as records does (quantUsdPerUnit); wbed-r3 1.1.0, wbed-r4 1.0.1 and wbed-r5 1.0.1 (their R3 packs). On dev 301-390 x d2-d5 the worlds, attempts, statements and labelled reasons are unchanged; only the printed quotes (at most one in the fourth decimal) and the US-cent totals moved. The frozen reference with author readings now passes 36/36 (validation/r3-bed-1.1.0.json). Regression tests: beds/wbed/lib/lib.test.mjs (every stored rate is its printed line), beds/wbed/r3/r3.test.mjs (rule 5 at the printed quotes reproduces by_reason and totals), references.test.mjs (36/36)
bedFinding.claimStatusBeforeFix: blocks R3 end-to-end success claims until resolved (AGENTS.md: an invalid evaluator blocks claims)
